description: Complete list of Inclusion Routines (IRs) for the Aequitas Protocol identity verification system

inclusion_routines.name: Government ID Anchor
inclusion_routines.description: (Non-Negotiable Prerequisite) User must complete a one-time, AI-witnessed scan of a valid, government-issued photo ID (e.g., Passport, Driver's License) paired with a full-spectrum liveness check. This anchors the wallet to a legal identity.

inclusion_routines.name: Simple Liveness
inclusion_routines.description: Standard "turn head, smile, blink" check.

inclusion_routines.name: Randomized Pose
inclusion_routines.description: AI requests 3 random, complex poses (e.g., "left hand 3 fingers, touch right ear").

inclusion_routines.name: Emotional Response
inclusion_routines.description: AI requests user to display 3 random emotions (e.g., "Surprise," "Anger").

inclusion_routines.name: Voiceprint (Static)
inclusion_routines.description: User reads a standard phonetically-balanced phrase to create a voiceprint.

inclusion_routines.name: Voiceprint (Dynamic)
inclusion_routines.description: AI provides 3 random, complex "tongue-twister" phrases to be read aloud.

inclusion_routines.name: Gait Analysis
inclusion_routines.description: User walks 10 paces from the camera and back, proving a unique "walk."

inclusion_routines.name: Hand Geometry
inclusion_routines.description: User places their hand flat on a plain surface for AI to scan geometry and creases.

inclusion_routines.name: Iris Scan
inclusion_routines.description: (Requires high-res camera) User performs a close-up scan of their iris.

inclusion_routines.name: Keystroke Dynamics
inclusion_routines.description: User must type a 100-word paragraph provided by the AI. AI analyzes typing rhythm.

inclusion_routines.name: Signature Dynamics
inclusion_routines.description: User must sign their name 3 times on-screen with their finger or a stylus.

inclusion_routines.name: "Whisper" Authentication
inclusion_routines.description: User must whisper 3 secret words provided by the AI.

inclusion_routines.name: Saccadic Eye Movement
inclusion_routines.description: AI displays a fast-moving dot; user must follow it with their eyes only.

inclusion_routines.name: Multi-Modal Sync
inclusion_routines.description: User must tap the screen, snap their fingers, and say a word, all at the same time.

inclusion_routines.name: Light Response
inclusion_routines.description: AI flashes a white screen; AI analyzes pupil dilation response.

inclusion_routines.name: 3D Face Mesh
inclusion_routines.description: AI requests a 360-degree head rotation to build a detailed 3D mesh.

inclusion_routines.name: Micro-Expression Check
inclusion_routines.description: AI analyzes user's face for micro-expressions in response to 5 rapid images.

inclusion_routines.name: Voice Pitch Range
inclusion_routines.description: User must sing or speak a phrase from their lowest to highest pitch.

inclusion_routines.name: Held Breath
inclusion_routines.description: User must hold their breath for 20 seconds while AI monitors for micro-movements.

inclusion_routines.name: Coordinated Movement
inclusion_routines.description: AI requests user to tap their head and rub their stomach simultaneously.

inclusion_routines.name: Heart Rate (Camera)
inclusion_routines.description: User places finger over camera lens for 30 seconds for AI to estimate heart rate.

inclusion_routines.name: Credit/Debit Card
inclusion_routines.description: User must scan a physical card. AI verifies name (must match anchor) and card network.

inclusion_routines.name: Secondary ID
inclusion_routines.description: User scans a different non-anchor ID (e.g., student ID, work badge, library card).

inclusion_routines.name: Utility Bill (Physical)
inclusion_routines.description: User must show a paper utility bill (gas, electric) dated < 60 days.

inclusion_routines.name: Bank Statement (Physical)
inclusion_routines.description: User must show a paper bank statement.

inclusion_routines.name: Diploma / Degree
inclusion_routines.description: User scans a physical diploma. AI verifies institution and name.

inclusion_routines.name: Professional License
inclusion_routines.description: User scans a physical state-issued professional license (e.g., medical, law).

inclusion_routines.name: Car Keys / Fob
inclusion_routines.description: User must show a car key fob; AI requests user to press "lock" (verifies light).

inclusion_routines.name: Vehicle Registration
inclusion_routines.description: User scans official vehicle registration document.

inclusion_routines.name: Vehicle Title
inclusion_routines.description: User scans official vehicle title document.

inclusion_routines.name: Property Deed / Lease
inclusion_routines.description: User scans first page of a property deed or active lease agreement.

inclusion_routines.name: "The Fridge Raider"
inclusion_routines.description: AI-witnessed walk to kitchen; user must scan barcode of a common item (e.g., milk, ketchup).

inclusion_routines.name: Pet Scan
inclusion_routines.description: User must get their pet (dog/cat) on camera and have AI verify it is a live animal.

inclusion_routines.name: House Key
inclusion_routines.description: User must show a standard house key.

inclusion_routines.name: Prescription Medication
inclusion_routines.description: User shows a prescription bottle with their name (AI verifies name matches anchor).

inclusion_routines.name: Birth Certificate
inclusion_routines.description: User scans their birth certificate.

inclusion_routines.name: Social Security Card
inclusion_routines.description: (US) User scans their physical Social Security card.

inclusion_routines.name: Marriage Certificate
inclusion_routines.description: User scans their marriage certificate.

inclusion_routines.name: "The Bookshelf"
inclusion_routines.description: User must pull a physical book from a shelf and read the first sentence of a random page.

inclusion_routines.name: "The Sock Drawer"
inclusion_routines.description: AI-witnessed walk to a drawer; user must pull out a pair of socks.

inclusion_routines.name: "Junk Drawer"
inclusion_routines.description: User must show a "junk drawer" item (e.g., batteries, tape).

inclusion_routines.name: Passport (Secondary)
inclusion_routines.description: If IR-000 was a driver's license, user scans their passport.

inclusion_routines.name: Driver's License (Secondary)
inclusion_routines.description: If IR-000 was a passport, user scans their driver's license.

inclusion_routines.name: "The Spice Rack"
inclusion_routines.description: User must find and scan the barcode of a specific spice (e.g., "Paprika").

inclusion_routines.name: "Toolshed"
inclusion_routines.description: User must show a common tool (e.g., hammer, screwdriver).

inclusion_routines.name: Live Event Ticket
inclusion_routines.description: User shows a physical ticket for a concert/event on the day of the event.

inclusion_routines.name: Email Loop (Low Trust)
inclusion_routines.description: User clicks a verification link sent to a webmail (Gmail, Hotmail).

inclusion_routines.name: Email Loop (High Trust)
inclusion_routines.description: User clicks a verification link sent to a .edu, .gov, or corporate email.

inclusion_routines.name: SMS Verification
inclusion_routines.description: User provides a 6-digit code sent to their mobile number.

inclusion_routines.name: Utility Bill (Digital)
inclusion_routines.description: User must log in to their utility provider's website and show the PDF bill.

inclusion_routines.name: Bank Account (Digital)
inclusion_routines.description: User must log in to their bank's website. AI verifies the URL and user name.

inclusion_routines.name: Phone Bill (Digital)
inclusion_routines.description: User must log in to their mobile carrier's website and show the PDF bill.

inclusion_routines.name: Social Graph (LinkedIn)
inclusion_routines.description: User links a LinkedIn account. AI verifies > 100 connections and > 2 years history.

inclusion_routines.name: Social Graph (Facebook)
inclusion_routines.description: User links a Facebook account. AI verifies > 100 friends and > 5 years history.

inclusion_routines.name: Social Graph (Twitter/X)
inclusion_routines.description: User links a Twitter/X account. AI verifies > 100 followers and > 3 years history.

inclusion_routines.name: "Photo History" Quest
inclusion_routines.description: AI requests user to find a photo from their camera roll from a random date (e.g., "July 2022").

inclusion_routines.name: Device History
inclusion_routines.description: AI verifies the "age" of the mobile device OS (e.g., "first use > 2 years ago").

inclusion_routines.name: 2FA App Sync
inclusion_routines.description: User proves control of a 2FA app (e.g., Google Auth) by entering a time-based code.

inclusion_routines.name: Crypto Wallet (Holdings)
inclusion_routines.description: User signs a message with a different crypto wallet (BTC/ETH) holding > $100.

inclusion_routines.name: Crypto Wallet (Age)
inclusion_routines.description: User signs a message with a wallet that has an on-chain history > 3 years.

inclusion_routines.name: KYC Pass-Thru (Exchange)
inclusion_routines.description: User proves active, KYC-verified login at a major crypto exchange.

inclusion_routines.name: KYC Pass-Thru (Bank)
inclusion_routines.description: User proves active, KYC-verified login at a major online bank.

inclusion_routines.name: GitHub Account
inclusion_routines.description: User links a GitHub account. AI verifies > 1 year history and > 10 commits.

inclusion_routines.name: Stack Overflow Account
inclusion_routines.description: User links account with > 500 reputation.

inclusion_routines.name: Reddit Account
inclusion_routines.description: User links account with > 1,000 karma and > 3 years history.

inclusion_routines.name: "AGI Retrieval" (US)
inclusion_routines.description: User must log into IRS.gov and retrieve their AGI from the previous year's tax return.

inclusion_routines.name: "Credit Score" (US)
inclusion_routines.description: User logs into Credit Karma / Experian and shows their credit score.

inclusion_routines.name: Domain Ownership
inclusion_routines.description: User proves ownership of a domain name by adding a TXT record.

inclusion_routines.name: "Amazon Order History"
inclusion_routines.description: User logs into Amazon and shows an order from > 3 years ago.

inclusion_routines.name: "Netflix Profile"
inclusion_routines.description: User logs into Netflix and shows a profile with > 2 years of watch history.

inclusion_routines.name: "Spotify Profile"
inclusion_routines.description: User logs into Spotify and shows a profile with > 3 years of listening.

inclusion_routines.name: Steam Account
inclusion_routines.description: User links a Steam account with > $100 in games and > 3 years history.

inclusion_routines.name: "Paystub" (Digital)
inclusion_routines.description: User shows a PDF paystub from their employer dated < 30 days.

inclusion_routines.name: Insurance Portal
inclusion_routines.description: User logs into their car or health insurance portal.

inclusion_routines.name: "Google Maps History"
inclusion_routines.description: User shows their Google Maps timeline from a random, prior date.

inclusion_routines.name: PGP Key
inclusion_routines.description: User signs a message using a PGP key from a public keyserver.

inclusion_routines.name: Peer Vouch (Level 1)
inclusion_routines.description: User is vouched for (via signed message) by 1 other "Verified" user.

inclusion_routines.name: Peer Vouch (Level 2)
inclusion_routines.description: User is vouched for by 3 other "Verified" users.

inclusion_routines.name: Peer Vouch (Level 3)
inclusion_routines.description: User is vouched for by 5 other "Verified" users.

inclusion_routines.name: Live Vouch (Family)
inclusion_routines.description: User joins a live 3-way video call with a "Verified" user they claim is family.

inclusion_routines.name: Live Vouch (Spouse)
inclusion_routines.description: User joins a live video call with a "Verified" spouse. Both must show marriage cert.

inclusion_routines.name: Live Vouch (Friend)
inclusion_routines.description: User joins a live 3-way video call with a "Verified" user they claim is a friend.

inclusion_routines.name: Employer Vouch
inclusion_routines.description: A "Verified" user with a "Focus: Corporate" vouches for the user as an employee.

inclusion_routines.name: "Shared Secret"
inclusion_routines.description: User and a "Verified" friend are given 5 questions; must answer identically.

inclusion_routines.name: "In-Person Vouch"
inclusion_routines.description: User meets a "Verified" user in person; both scan a QR code at the same time/GPS.

inclusion_routines.name: "Notary Vouch"
inclusion_routines.description: A "Verified" public notary performs a remote online notarization for the user.

inclusion_routines.name: "Doctor Vouch"
inclusion_routines.description: A "Verified" user with a "Focus: Medical" vouches for the user as a patient.

inclusion_routines.name: "Landlord Vouch"
inclusion_routines.description: A "Verified" user with a "Focus: Property" vouches for the user as a tenant.

inclusion_routines.name: "Alumni Vouch"
inclusion_routines.description: User is vouched for by 3 "Verified" users who are also verified alumni of the same school.

inclusion_routines.name: "Conference Vouch"
inclusion_routines.description: User attends a real-world event and gets 5 "Verified" attendees to vouch for them.

inclusion_routines.name: "Family Photo"
inclusion_routines.description: User and 3 "Verified" family members must all join a video call at the same time.

inclusion_routines.name: "Pet Vouch"
inclusion_routines.description: User and a "Verified" friend must both show their pets on a live video call.

inclusion_routines.name: "Local Vouch"
inclusion_routines.description: User is vouched for by 3 "Verified" users who live in the same zip code.

inclusion_routines.name: "Hobby Vouch"
inclusion_routines.description: User is vouched for by 3 "Verified" users who are part of a verified "Hobby" club.

inclusion_routines.name: "Gamer Vouch"
inclusion_routines.description: User is vouched for by 3 "Verified" users from the same "Verified" gaming guild.

inclusion_routines.name: "Co-Worker Vouch"
inclusion_routines.description: User is vouched for by 3 "Verified" users who all work at the same "Verified" company.

inclusion_routines.name: "Mailbox Quest"
inclusion_routines.description: AI-witnessed walk (with GPS) to user's home mailbox. User must retrieve a piece of mail.

inclusion_routines.name: "Home" Check-in
inclusion_routines.description: User checks in from their verified home address GPS coordinates.

inclusion_routines.name: "Work" Check-in
inclusion_routines.description: User checks in from their verified work address GPS coordinates.

inclusion_routines.name: "ATM Visit"
inclusion_routines.description: User goes to a bank ATM, enables mic, and AI listens for ATM machine sounds.

inclusion_routines.name: "Post Office" Quest
inclusion_routines.description: User goes to a Post Office, buys a stamp, and scans the receipt. GPS must match.

inclusion_routines.name: "Public Landmark"
inclusion_routines.description: AI gives user a quest to visit a specific, random public landmark in their city.

inclusion_routines.name: "Daily Commute"
inclusion_routines.description: User records their commute (home to work) for 3 consecutive days.

inclusion_routines.name: "Store Receipt"
inclusion_routines.description: User buys an item from a store and scans the receipt. GPS must match store.

inclusion_routines.name: "Gas Station"
inclusion_routines.description: User buys gas and scans the receipt. AI matches GPS and receipt data.

inclusion_routines.name: "Coffee Shop"
inclusion_routines.description: User buys a coffee and scans the receipt.

inclusion_routines.name: "Library Visit"
inclusion_routines.description: User visits a public library, logs into the WiFi, and shows the portal.

inclusion_routines.name: "Airport" Check-in
inclusion_routines.description: User scans a boarding pass at an airport on the day of travel.

inclusion_routines.name: "Hotel" Check-in
inclusion_routines.description: User scans their hotel room key card and shows the hotel's WiFi portal.

inclusion_routines.name: "National Park"
inclusion_routines.description: User visits a national park and takes a photo of a specific (AI-requested) sign.

inclusion_routines.name: "Cemetery Visit"
inclusion_routines.description: AI gives user quest to find a specific (publicly listed) tombstone and take a photo.

inclusion_routines.name: "DMV Visit"
inclusion_routines.description: (Failure Recovery) User enables AI witness, goes to DMV, and scans a queue ticket.

inclusion_routines.name: "Bank Visit"
inclusion_routines.description: (Failure Recovery) User enables AI witness, goes to bank, and scans a deposit receipt.

inclusion_routines.name: "Police Station"
inclusion_routines.description: User takes a photo of the front of a local police station. GPS must match.

inclusion_routines.name: "Public Transport"
inclusion_routines.description: User scans a valid public transport ticket (bus, subway) during rush hour.

inclusion_routines.name: "Sunrise" Quest
inclusion_routines.description: User must take a live, AI-witnessed video of the sunrise.

inclusion_routines.name: "Sunset" Quest
inclusion_routines.description: User must take a live, AI-witnessed video of the sunset.

inclusion_routines.name: "Local Weather"
inclusion_routines.description: User must perform a specific action (e.g., "show the rain") during a verified local weather event.

inclusion_routines.name: "Grocery Run"
inclusion_routines.description: User must scan 5 specific, common items (e.g., Apple, Bread) at a grocery store.

inclusion_routines.name: "International" Check-in
inclusion_routines.description: User checks in from a GPS location outside their home country.

inclusion_routines.name: "Border Crossing"
inclusion_routines.description: User scans a passport stamp within 24 hours of receiving it.

inclusion_routines.name: Remote Online Notary
inclusion_routines.description: User completes a full, live, AI-witnessed Remote Online Notarization (RON).

inclusion_routines.name: Bank Letter
inclusion_routines.description: User scans a physically mailed, recent "Letter of Good Standing" from their bank.

inclusion_routines.name: Credit Score (Hard)
inclusion_routines.description: User initiates a "hard pull" of their credit, proving access to their SSN/SIN.

inclusion_routines.name: Professional License (Active)
inclusion_routines.description: AI verifies user's name on a live state/gov't database (e.g., state bar, medical board).

inclusion_routines.name: Voter Registration
inclusion_routines.description: AI verifies user's name and address on a public voter registration roll.

inclusion_routines.name: Property Ownership
inclusion_routines.description: AI verifies user's name on a public county/city property tax database.

inclusion_routines.name: Tax Return (Full)
inclusion_routines.description: User uploads a redacted copy of their last federal tax return (AI matches name, AGI).

inclusion_routines.name: Pilot's License
inclusion_routines.description: AI verifies user's name on the FAA (or equivalent) pilot database.

inclusion_routines.name: Amateur Radio License
inclusion_routines.description: AI verifies user's call sign and name on the FCC (or equivalent) database.

inclusion_routines.name: Military ID
inclusion_routines.description: User scans a valid (non-classified) military ID or veteran's card.

inclusion_routines.name: "Trusted Traveler"
inclusion_routines.description: User scans their Global Entry, NEXUS, or SENTRI card.

inclusion_routines.name: Academic Publication
inclusion_routines.description: User proves authorship of a paper in a recognized academic journal.

inclusion_routines.name: Corporate Officer
inclusion_routines.description: AI verifies user's name as a registered officer of a corporation.

inclusion_routines.name: Security Clearance
inclusion_routines.description: User attests to holding a (non-verifiable) clearance; high-value "honeypot" task.

inclusion_routines.name: "Proof-of-Debt"
inclusion_routines.description: User proves login to their student loan or mortgage provider portal.

inclusion_routines.name: Court Record
inclusion_routines.description: User proves they are a party in a (public) civil court filing.

inclusion_routines.name: UCC Filing
inclusion_routines.description: User proves they are party to a Uniform Commercial Code filing.

inclusion_routines.name: Patent Ownership
inclusion_routines.description: User proves they are the listed inventor on a granted patent.

inclusion_routines.name: "Proof-of-Insurance"
inclusion_routines.description: User shows their active, digital insurance card (auto, health).

inclusion_routines.name: Business License
inclusion_routines.description: User scans a city or state-issued business license.

inclusion_routines.name: Daily Check-in
inclusion_routines.description: User completes a simple liveness check for 7 consecutive days.

inclusion_routines.name: Weekly Quest
inclusion_routines.description: User completes one random, AI-assigned IR (from any Arena) for 4 consecutive weeks.

inclusion_routines.name: "Proof-of-Life" (30d)
inclusion_routines.description: User maintains the app's "heartbeat" (passive check-in) for 30 days.

inclusion_routines.name: "Proof-of-Life" (90d)
inclusion_routines.description: User maintains the app's "heartbeat" for 90 days.

inclusion_routines.name: "Proof-of-Life" (365d)
inclusion_routines.description: User maintains the app's "heartbeat" for 1 full year.

inclusion_routines.name: "Financial Transaction"
inclusion_routines.description: User proves 1 financial transaction (e.g., coffee) every day for 5 days.

inclusion_routines.name: "Data Feed"
inclusion_routines.description: User provides a "read-only" API feed from their bank for 30 days.

inclusion_routines.name: "Health Data"
inclusion_routines.description: User provides a "read-only" feed from their health app (e.g., Apple Health) for 30 days.

inclusion_routines.name: "Node Uptime"
inclusion_routines.description: (Advanced) User runs a light node for the Aequitas protocol for 30 days.

inclusion_routines.name: "Commute" (Monthly)
inclusion_routines.description: User proves their daily commute (IR-507) once per month for 6 months.

inclusion_routines.name: "Bill Pay"
inclusion_routines.description: User proves they paid 3 different utility bills over a 3-month period.

inclusion_routines.name: "Social Media"
inclusion_routines.description: User makes one "verified" post on a linked social account every week for a month.

inclusion_routines.name: "AI Check-in"
inclusion_routines.description: User has a 2-minute "conversation" with their AI assistant once a week for a month.

inclusion_routines.name: "Random Audit"
inclusion_routines.description: User agrees to "random audits" and successfully completes 3 random IRs within 1 hour.

inclusion_routines.name: "Wallet Age"
inclusion_routines.description: (Passive) The user's Aequitas wallet itself ages 1 year.

inclusion_routines.name: Aadhaar Sync (India)
inclusion_routines.description: User completes a verification using the Aadhaar biometric/OTP system.

inclusion_routines.name: eIDAS Sync (EU)
inclusion_routines.description: User completes a verification using their eIDAS compatible national ID.

inclusion_routines.name: My Number Sync (Japan)
inclusion_routines.description: User completes a verification using their "My Number" card.

inclusion_routines.name: SIN Sync (Canada)
inclusion_routines.description: User proves knowledge of their Social Insurance Number (paired with other ID).

inclusion_routines.name: WeChat Pay (China)
inclusion_routines.description: User proves active, verified login to WeChat Pay.

inclusion_routines.name: Alipay (China)
inclusion_routines.description: User proves active, verified login to Alipay with "Zhima Credit."

inclusion_routines.name: KakaoPay (S. Korea)
inclusion_routines.description: User proves active, verified login to KakaoPay.

inclusion_routines.name: "University ID"
inclusion_routines.description: User scans a valid, active Student ID from any accredited university.

inclusion_routines.name: "Alumni Status"
inclusion_routines.description: AI verifies user's name on a university's public alumni donation list.

inclusion_routines.name: "Public Library Card"
inclusion_routines.description: User scans their local public library card.

inclusion_routines.name: "Costco" Card
inclusion_routines.description: User scans their Costco or other wholesale club membership card.

inclusion_routines.name: "Frequent Flyer"
inclusion_routines.description: User proves > 50k miles status on a major airline.

inclusion_routines.name: "Blood Donor"
inclusion_routines.description: User scans their official blood donor card.

inclusion_routines.name: "Organ Donor"
inclusion_routines.description: User shows their driver's license (or other ID) with the organ donor symbol.

inclusion_routines.name: "Hunting/Fishing"
inclusion_routines.description: User scans a valid, state-issued hunting or fishing license.

inclusion_routines.name: "Concealed Carry"
inclusion_routines.description: User scans their (non-federal) concealed carry weapon permit.

inclusion_routines.name: "Verified Gamer"
inclusion_routines.description: User links a "Verified" account from a partner gaming service (e.g., Blizzard).

inclusion_routines.name: "Spotify" (Top 1%)
inclusion_routines.description: User proves they were in the "Top 1% of Listeners" for an artist.

inclusion_routines.name: "First Email"
inclusion_routines.description: User proves access to their email account by forwarding their "Welcome to Gmail/Hotmail" email.

inclusion_routines.name: "Notary Public"
inclusion_routines.description: User proves they are a Notary Public by scanning their commission.

inclusion_routines.name: "Clergy"
inclusion_routines.description: User proves they are ordained clergy via a recognized religious body.

inclusion_routines.name: "Farm"
inclusion_routines.description: User proves ownership of livestock (e.g., ear tag) or a registered "Farm" vehicle.

inclusion_routines.name: "Ham Radio"
inclusion_routines.description: User (IR-609) performs a live, AI-witnessed broadcast of their call sign.

inclusion_routines.name: "MENSA"
inclusion_routines.description: User scans their MENSA membership card.

inclusion_routines.name: "Reservation"
inclusion_routines.description: (US) User scans their "Certificate of Degree of Indian Blood" or tribal ID.

arenas.name: Knowledge

arenas.name: High-Assurance
arenas.description: Proving connection to high-trust, official, and financial systems

arenas.name: Persistence
